queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'GNU Privacy Guard' AND publisher = 'The GnuPG Project';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'GNU Privacy Guard' AND publisher = 'The GnuPG Project' AND version_compare(version, '2.5.22') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'gnu privacy guard.exe');
